model.name: Point

vars.description: This parameter contains information on the coordinate range for its Geometries, Features or FeatureCollections. It describes a bounding box for this. The coordinates are given in the decimal degrees unit. In the following it is described, which value of the array represents which coordinate:   - The most southwesterly point: Longitude   - The most southwesterly point: Latitude   - The most northeasterly point: Longitude   - The most northeasterly point: Latitude
vars.name: bbox

  - The most northeasterly point: Longitude
  - The most northeasterly point: Latitude

vars.description: A Point is described by its coordinate, given in the decimal degrees unit. In the following it is described, which value of the array represents which coordinate:   - Longitude   - Latitude  A example, given in the [RFC7946 - The GeoJSON format](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7946#appendix-A.1)
